kant.author: Immanuel Kant
kant.work: Fundamental Principles of the Metaphysic of Morals (Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals)
kant.note: Source of the formula of universal law, the formula of humanity and the false-promise example.

mill.author: John Stuart Mill
mill.note: Source of the greatest-happiness principle, the quality of pleasures, secondary principles and the importance of trustworthiness.

aristotle.author: Aristotle
aristotle.location: Book VI, Chapters 5 and 7; Book VIII, Chapter 3
aristotle.note: Source of practical wisdom (phronesis), its focus on particulars, and the kinds of friendship.
